title: content.setKey
description: Sets the key of a content, as choosing a key in OpenTune's transport bar does for the selected clip. As in the UI there is no undo entry: undo has reason ui_parity and a revert recipe that restores the previous root and scale and carries the key revision after the change. The revert is partial: content.setKey always sets a manual key, so the restored key has origin manual and confidence null, and a detected key's origin and confidence are not restored. expectedKeyRevision, if given, guards against a concurrent key change (REVISION_CONFLICT(key_changed)). Setting the key the content already has is a no-op. A key change does not change revision (PROTOCOL.md section 10 rule 2). If the clip is selected, the scale shown in the transport bar follows; this is reported as sideEffects.uiScaleChanged, whose revert is the result's revert recipe.
